notes.title: French, Spanish, Russian and Lithuanian Translations Available
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/be3482427e23e534ab3396df16f848fcc7db64dc.png"][/img][/h1][p]On the main menu, there is now a button that allows you to play the demo in a different language (Currently: [b]French, Spanish, Russian and Lithuanian[/b]).[/p][p]These translations were only possible because of the graciousness of the volunteers! I enjoyed working with them to make the translations as good as they can be. Their names are mentioned in the new credits menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]Report translation bugs![/h2][p]It is impossible for me to playtest and proofread every translation fully. There is bound to be a typo, a strange sentence, or even a crash that has slipped my attention! If that happens, please [url="https://growagirlfriend.com/#contact-iframe"]email me[/url]. I am on hot-fix duty and will resolve any issues ASAP so that each game build is an improvement for the next player.[/p][p]I am not native in these languages, so if anything seems odd, please be like Button below and make sure no bugs roam free! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45671974/7a2a69702f5dec284660708f9a93fe07d1f0e072.png"][/img][i]Entomologists will note that ladybugs are actually beetles, not bugs! Too bad I didn't consider that until after I drew this.[/i][/p]
